game.title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A
game.notes: Genesis Mode. Neither Nintendo Switch nor Switch 2 has a native achievement/trophy system, and no other platform release exists. Game content and story are confirmed identical between the Switch and Switch 2 Editions (only performance/resolution differ), so this list applies to either. Revised after audit: an initial draft included three trophies built around a 'Zygarde Cell' collectible system — that mechanic does not exist in this game (it was confused with the Sun/Moon-era Zygarde Cell hunt); Legends Z-A catches and completes Zygarde in a single scripted postgame boss fight instead, so those trophies were removed/reworked. The initial draft also placed 'Rogue Mega Rush' (which requires the paid Mega Dimension DLC, since its 27-fight roster includes the DLC-exclusive Mega Zeraora) in the base list, which would have made the base Platinum depend on paid DLC in violation of Rule 14 — it has been moved into the Mega Dimension DLC list instead. Other scope decisions: (1) Mewtwo and Diancie ARE included (PLZA-023, PLZA-024) despite both requiring a real-world, time-distributed Mystery Gift code to access — an explicit user override of the precedent set earlier in this project (comparable amiibo-gated content was dropped from Skyward Sword); both are marked missable with notes on the external-code dependency. (2) The Mega Dimension paid DLC gets its own trophy list under `dlc`, per Rule 14 and explicit user request; it never affects the base Platinum. (3) The postgame character 'L' is deliberately NOT named as Lysandre in any trophy text — that identity comes only from low-confidence community plot summaries, not confirmed in-game dialogue. (4) Mega Pidgeot, despite heavy pre-release marketing, is confirmed to be a backstory-only event, never a player-controlled battle — no trophy is built around it. (5) 'A Request from the Rust Syndicate' and 'An Invitation from the SBC' are mandatory main-story missions, not optional side quests (corrected from an initial mistyping) — they're typed `story`, and the Boutique Couture unlock (defeating designer Asami while the player's own Pokémon is Mega Evolved — corrected from an initial description that had this backwards) is folded into the SBC mission trophy rather than double-counted as its own entry. (6) The exact base-game side mission total is inconsistent across sources (119-121), so no trophy references a specific side-mission count. (7) No multiplayer/Link Play trophies are included per Rule 13, since online functionality cannot be guaranteed available to every future player. (8) PLZA-027 (Pokédex completion) is marked missable: a low-confidence report suggests at least one required species may have only a single non-repeatable encounter in the entire game — flagged as a caution rather than asserted as fact, since it wasn't independently confirmed. (9) A second audit round found the Mega Dimension DLC's actual endgame extends well past Mega Darkrai: a targeted follow-up scout confirmed defeating Darkrai only rolls the DLC's story credits and opens a further mandatory postgame chain — Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre (Mission 12's continuation, gated behind Hyperspace survey-point thresholds), then a two-phase Mega Rayquaza fight at the Hyperspace Sky Pillar, which community sources treat as the DLC's true climax (though no distinct in-game 'True Ending' cutscene or menu flag could be confirmed, so that specific terminology is avoided in trophy text). The DLC list was expanded from 12 to 16 trophies to cover Rogue Mega Heatran (the mandatory pre-Darkrai boss), Groudon, Kyogre, Rayquaza, and the hidden 'Raging Lightning' side mission that actually unlocks Mega Zeraora (previously described only as 'obtain the stone' without its real, substantial unlock chain). The Rogue Mega Rush trophy's verification was corrected to cite the confirmed 'Mega Rush Master' title reward rather than a vague 'completion reward.' Gold-tier weighting in the DLC list (8 of 16) is intentional for the same reason as the base list: this expansion's entire purpose is its endgame content, and trimming it would mean cutting the content players bought the DLC for.

trophies.name: Ace Recruit
trophies.description: Join Team MZ and begin climbing the Z-A Royale.
trophies.verification: The introductory story missions conclude with the player officially recognized as a Team MZ member.

trophies.name: Roll With It
trophies.description: Perform a dodge-roll in real-time battle for the first time.
trophies.verification: The dodge-roll animation plays in response to the input during a battle.

trophies.name: Silent Approach
trophies.description: Sneak up on and catch a wild Pokémon while crouched, undetected.
trophies.verification: The Pokémon is caught without having entered an alerted state beforehand.

trophies.name: A Mysterious Absol
trophies.description: Encounter Mega Absol and receive the Mega Bracelet.
trophies.verification: The Mega Bracelet is added to the player's equipment following the encounter's cutscene.

trophies.name: Awakened Power
trophies.description: Mega Evolve a Pokémon for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Mega Evolution transformation animation plays in battle.

trophies.name: First Stone
trophies.description: Defeat your first Rogue Mega Evolution and claim its Mega Stone.
trophies.verification: The Rogue Mega Evolution's defeat cutscene plays and its Mega Stone is added to the Bag.

trophies.name: Climbing the Ladder
trophies.description: Reach Rank F in the Z-A Royale.
trophies.verification: The Z-A Royale menu shows the current rank as F.

trophies.name: A Glimmer in the Crowd
trophies.description: Catch a Shiny Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Shiny Pokémon is added to the party or box with its distinct color and sparkle animation.

trophies.name: Field Notes
trophies.description: Claim your first reward from Mable's Research.
trophies.verification: The Mable's Research menu shows a claimed reward at Research Level 1 or higher.

trophies.name: Beneath the Streets
trophies.description: Discover the entrance to the Lumiose Sewers.
trophies.verification: The Lumiose Sewers area loads and appears on the map.

trophies.name: Growing Dex
trophies.description: Register 50 species in the Lumiose Pokédex.
trophies.verification: The Pokédex app on the Rotom Phone shows 50 species registered.

trophies.name: Swarm Silenced
trophies.description: Defeat Rogue Mega Beedrill.
trophies.verification: Rogue Mega Beedrill's defeat triggers the mission's clear cutscene and Beedrillite is added to the Bag.

trophies.name: Full House
trophies.description: Fill your first Pokémon storage box.
trophies.verification: The Box/Storage screen shows a box holding its full 30 Pokémon.

trophies.name: New Ground
trophies.description: Unlock your 10th Wild Zone.
trophies.verification: The city map shows a 10th Wild Zone marked as unlocked.

trophies.name: The Debt Collector
trophies.description: Complete the mandatory "A Request from the Rust Syndicate" story mission chain.
trophies.verification: The mission chain is marked complete on the map's mission list.

trophies.name: An Invitation Answered
trophies.description: Complete the mandatory "An Invitation from the SBC" story mission chain, defeating fashion designer Asami while your own Pokémon is Mega Evolved to unlock Boutique Couture along the way.
trophies.verification: The mission chain is marked complete on the map's mission list, and Boutique Couture is open for shopping at Promenade du Vent.

trophies.name: Champion's Toolkit
trophies.description: Reach Level 100 with a Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Pokémon's summary screen shows Level 100.

trophies.name: Full Bloom
trophies.description: Reach Research Level 25 with Mable.
trophies.verification: The Mable's Research menu shows Research Level 25.

trophies.name: Storm on the Ladder
trophies.description: Reach Rank A in the Z-A Royale and defeat Urbain/Taunie in the final Promotion Match.
trophies.verification: The Z-A Royale menu shows Rank A, and the Promotion Match's clear cutscene has played.

trophies.name: Every Corner
trophies.description: Unlock all 20 Wild Zones.
trophies.verification: The city map screen shows no remaining locked Wild Zone.

trophies.name: The One That Gives
trophies.description: Track down and catch Xerneas in the postgame.
trophies.verification: Xerneas is added to the party or box.

trophies.name: The One That Takes
trophies.description: Track down and catch Yveltal in the postgame.
trophies.verification: Yveltal is added to the party or box.

trophies.name: Reunion at Lysandre Labs
trophies.description: Catch Mewtwo in Lysandre Labs. Requires redeeming the Mewtwonite X/Y Mystery Gift code from its real-world distribution.
trophies.verification: Mewtwo is added to the party or box.
trophies.notes: Depends on an external, time-distributed Mystery Gift code rather than anything unlocked purely through play. Included at explicit user request despite that dependency.

trophies.name: Shine Bright
trophies.description: Catch Diancie via the "Shine Bright like a Gemstone" postgame mission. Requires redeeming the Diancite Mystery Gift code from its real-world distribution.
trophies.verification: Diancie is added to the party or box.
trophies.notes: Depends on an external, time-distributed Mystery Gift code rather than anything unlocked purely through play. Included at explicit user request despite that dependency.

trophies.name: The Bonds That Balance
trophies.description: Defeat Hyperrogue Ange Floette and bring the main story to its end.
trophies.verification: Hyperrogue Ange Floette's defeat triggers the story's ending sequence and credits.

trophies.name: Stone Collector
trophies.description: Obtain every Rogue Mega Evolution's Mega Stone from the 16 base-game Rogue Mega battles.
trophies.verification: The Bag's Mega Stone pocket screen shows every base-game Rogue Mega Evolution's stone present.

trophies.name: Pokémon Professor
trophies.description: Complete the Lumiose Pokédex.
trophies.verification: The Pokédex app shows every required species registered and awards the "Pokémon Professor" title.
trophies.notes: Marked missable out of caution: an unconfirmed, low-confidence report suggests at least one required species may have only a single non-repeatable encounter in the whole game. Not independently verified — flagged so the player double-checks a guide before passing up any unfamiliar single encounter, rather than discovering a locked-out Pokédex late.

trophies.name: Master Researcher
trophies.description: Complete Mable's Research by reaching its final Research Level and claiming the Shiny Charm.
trophies.verification: The Mable's Research menu shows the final Research Level reached and the Shiny Charm claimed.

trophies.name: To Keep the World in Balance
trophies.description: Catch Zygarde during the postgame mission "To Keep the World in Balance," watching it reach Complete Forme mid-battle.
trophies.verification: Zygarde's model changes to Complete Forme as its HP drops during the scripted battle, and it is caught and added to the party or box at the mission's climax.

trophies.name: Eternal Bloom
trophies.description: Win 15 reward matches in the Infinite Z-A Royale to obtain Eternal Flower Floette and Floettite.
trophies.verification: The Infinite Z-A Royale menu's win record shows the 15th win, and Eternal Flower Floette and Floettite are added to the party/Bag.

trophies.name: Hero of Lumiose
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.

trophies.name: Through the Portal
trophies.description: Meet Hoopa and step through the first portal into Hyperspace Lumiose.
trophies.verification: The Hyperspace Lumiose area loads for the first time following the portal cutscene.

trophies.name: Sweet Fortune
trophies.description: Craft a Sparkling Power Donut for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Sparkling Power Donut appears in the Bag after crafting.

trophies.name: Hyperspace Debut
trophies.description: Register your first species in the Hyperspace Pokédex.
trophies.verification: The Hyperspace Pokédex tab shows one species registered.

trophies.name: New Frontier
trophies.description: Unlock your first Hyperspace Wild Zone.
trophies.verification: A Hyperspace Wild Zone appears unlocked on the Hyperspace map.

trophies.name: Rematch
trophies.description: Defeat a Rogue Mega Evolution rematch in Hyperspace for the first time.
trophies.verification: The rematch's defeat is recorded in the Hyperspace mission log and its Hyperspace Pokédex entry.

trophies.name: Past the Old Limit
trophies.description: Reach Level 150 with a Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Pokémon's summary screen shows Level 150.

trophies.name: Every Hyperspace Reached
trophies.description: Unlock every Hyperspace Wild Zone.
trophies.verification: The Hyperspace map shows no remaining locked Wild Zone.

trophies.name: Molten Gatekeeper
trophies.description: Defeat Rogue Mega Heatran in Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 5, the mandatory battle guarding the way to the Darkrai finale.
trophies.verification: Rogue Mega Heatran's defeat triggers Survey No. 5's clear cutscene and Heatranite is added to the Bag.

trophies.name: The Dream's End
trophies.description: Defeat and catch Rogue Mega Darkrai in Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 6, rolling the Hyperspace Lumiose story's credits and opening its postgame.
trophies.verification: Rogue Mega Darkrai's two-phase fight ends in its capture, and the story's credits sequence plays.

trophies.name: Hyperspace Professor
trophies.description: Complete the Hyperspace Pokédex.
trophies.verification: The Hyperspace Pokédex tab shows every required species registered and awards the "Hyperspace Pokémon Professor" title.

trophies.name: A Ruby-Red Legend
trophies.description: Craft the Omega Old-Fashioned Donut and catch Primal Groudon during "The Greatest Gift"'s postgame continuation.
trophies.verification: Groudon undergoes Primal Reversion after being weakened with the Red Orb, and is caught and added to the party or box.

trophies.name: A Sapphire-Blue Legend
trophies.description: Craft the Alpha Old-Fashioned Donut and catch Primal Kyogre during "The Greatest Gift"'s postgame continuation.
trophies.verification: Kyogre undergoes Primal Reversion after being weakened with the Blue Orb, and is caught and added to the party or box.

trophies.name: Ascension
trophies.description: Craft the Delta Old-Fashioned Donut, travel to the Hyperspace Sky Pillar, and defeat and catch Mega Rayquaza to bring the Mega Dimension's story to its true end.
trophies.verification: Rayquaza Mega Evolves via Dragon Ascent mid-battle in its two-phase fight, is caught and added to the party or box, and the Rogue Mega Rush challenge unlocks afterward.

trophies.name: Raging Lightning
trophies.description: Complete the hidden "Raging Lightning" side mission — unlocked after finishing "The Greatest Gift" and the base game's Diancie and Mewtwo side missions — to catch Rogue Mega Zeraora and obtain Zeraorite.
trophies.verification: Rogue Mega Zeraora's defeat ends the "Raging Lightning" mission, and Zeraorite is added to the Bag.
trophies.notes: Depends on the base game's EX1 (Diancie) and EX2 (Mewtwo) side missions already being complete, which in turn depend on the same external, time-distributed Mystery Gift codes flagged on PLZA-023/PLZA-024. If those codes were never redeemed or their distribution window has closed, this trophy is permanently unobtainable.

trophies.name: New Ceiling
trophies.description: Reach Level 164, the Mega Dimension's raised maximum level, with a Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Pokémon's summary screen shows Level 164.

trophies.name: Unbreakable Streak
trophies.description: Clear the Rogue Mega Rush: defeat all 27 Level-100 Rogue Mega Evolution rematches — every base-game and Hyperspace Rogue Mega, plus Zygarde — with a single team, using no more than 3 full heals and no items.
trophies.verification: The 27th and final rematch is defeated under the Rush's conditions, awarding the equippable "Mega Rush Master" title under Titles in the profile menu.
trophies.notes: The 27-fight roster includes a Zeraora rematch, which inherits the same Mewtwo/Diancie Mystery Gift dependency as PLZAMD-014 — see that entry's notes. If Zeraora was never obtained, the Rush cannot be completed.
